title: Georgia voters share thoughts on race for governor, US Senate and issues

 Politics Interactive: What Georgia voters say about races for governor, US Senate
 A new AJC poll finds a close race for Georgia governor and Jon Ossoff leading the U.S. Senate race. Share A man walks into the Buckhead Library during early voting for the Georgia general election on Tuesday, Oct. 20, 2026, in Atlanta. (Jason Getz/AJC) By Isaac Sabetai and Charles Minshew Oct 23, 2026 A new poll from The Atlanta Journal-Constitution shows who is leading the race for Georgia governor, U.S. Senate and other key statewide offices. It also shows what voters think about issues ranging from the economy to data centers to surveillance cameras. 
 The AJC poll of 1,000 likely general election voters in Georgia was conducted via telephone by the University of Georgia’s School of Public and International Affairs during Oct. 7-15. The margin of error is 3.1 percentage points.
 Likely voters are those who cast a ballot in the 2022 general election, and/or the 2024 general election and/or the 2026 statewide primary; who indicated they were currently registered to vote in Georgia; and who were definitely or probably will vote in the 2026 general election.
